token.label: KION Music Token
token.description: Enter your KION Music OAuth token. See the documentation for how to obtain it.

my_wave_max_tracks.label: My Mix maximum tracks
my_wave_max_tracks.description: Maximum number of tracks to fetch for My Mix playlist. Lower values load faster but provide fewer tracks. Default: 150.

liked_tracks_max_tracks.label: Liked Tracks maximum tracks
liked_tracks_max_tracks.description: Maximum number of tracks to show in Liked Tracks virtual playlist. Higher values may significantly increase load time. Lower values load faster. Default: 500.

transport.label: Streaming transport
transport.description: Transport mode for audio streaming. 'raw' — direct unencrypted stream (default). 'encraw' — AES-CTR encrypted stream (fallback).

codecs.label: Codecs override
codecs.description: Comma-separated codec list to override quality-based defaults. Leave empty to use defaults. Example: 'flac-mp4,flac,aac-mp4,aac,mp3'.

base_url.label: API Base URL
base_url.description: API endpoint base URL. Only change if KION Music changes their API endpoint. Default: {0}

manifest.description: Stream music, personalized recommendations, and lossless FLAC from KION Music — including My Wave radio and library sync.
